digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter module relocation and loader configuration
propositions: Eight Jira modules currently at package root must be physically moved into adapters/jira/ subdirectory per ADR 0035 requirements
Three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) require loader updates to use relative subpaths without breaking other root module lookups
Approximately 29 surviving references across dotted imports and sibling-path loads must be atomically repointed to new adapter paths in the same change
Test surface spanning ~23 object-level patches (path-agnostic, unaffected), ~18 path-constant specs, and ~18 direct dotted imports must be rewritten to new locations
Loader changes must resolve the three location-pinned modules via relative subpath while preserving the ~30 other root modules' dynamic loading capability
No re-export shims or behavior changes permitted; the move is purely structural and must be verified by zero grep hits for old root paths and full test suite passing
